purpose: Test language understanding for repeated reuse of registered skills, where exact-address KV alone is insufficient, while retaining strong lexical and pretrained implementations.
task_scope: Instruction-to-skill selection and explicitly decomposed composition; no claim of algorithm synthesis, learned planning, arbitrary new fact memory, or open-domain generality.
information: All selectors receive the identical raw request text and V13 train/calibration examples. Payloads go to the identical shared executor. No selector receives skill labels, expected outputs, project-to-label maps, or holdout metadata.

sources.new_project_names: Aurora project distractors now come from a single frozen salted hash of request body only, independent of labels, indexes, oracle metadata, and row order. They remain unseen in train/calibration. Same previously evaluated requests; no new independent holdout samples.

statistical_units: The same 96 authored requests are used for all seeds; optimizer seeds are not 288 independent language examples. Queries and their skill groups must remain paired in inference.

training_and_selection.linear_reader: 128-to-12, same initialization for LoRA and frozen linear control
training_and_selection.lexical_features: TFIDF word unigrams/bigrams plus char_wb 2-5 grams
training_and_selection.selection: V13 calibration executed task success, then label accuracy, then earliest candidate; never new holdout outcomes.

acceptance.quality: A target improves held-out actual execution success over every prespecified implementation baseline, consistently across the three fixed seeds. Costs and label accuracy are separately reported.
acceptance.net_utility: At 1000 reads/one-hour storage window, actual execution success minus 0.01 reward per total wall-second/query minus 0.001 reward per GiB-hour/query exceeds every prespecified baseline.
acceptance.statistical_review: Root aggregation must account for shared requests across seeds and paired skill/query groups; single-seed candidate flags do not establish stable gain.
acceptance.energy_dollars_and_unimplemented_distrib: Explicit unknowns outside the local service claim; not additional quality gates.

included: known previous failed and unsuccessful exploration
cost_scope.prior_cost_ledger: semantic_prior_costs.json; optional override accepts cost-only entries, never prior holdout predictions
cost_scope.unknown_prior_costs: Remain null and visible; never treated as measured zero. Quality evidence remains assessable, while complete research-amortized cost claims require these values.

paired_bugfix.reason: Original query project IDs explicitly encoded the gold category and within-category index. Repair this construction error without retuning on observed quality.
paired_bugfix.statistical_interpretation: A paired cue-removal sensitivity check on the same evaluated 96 requests and 12 compositions. Original negative results remain reported. No new independent generalization evidence and no hyperparameter selection from either held-out result.
